sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Summer '26 Release: Multi-Agent Orchestration, Slack-First Sales, and Real-Time Offer Management
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce announced its Summer '26 release going live June 15, headlined by Agentforce Multi-Agent Orchestration, which enables AI agents to collaborate on complex end-to-end workflows with shared context across channels. The release also introduces Slack-First Sales with proactive AI agents for prospecting and pipeline management, Real-Time Offer Management for personalised promotions, and native RCS messaging support in Marketing Cloud Next.
sfdc_news.relevance: Salesforce admins and marketers gain powerful new AI orchestration and channel capabilities that can significantly accelerate campaign execution and customer engagement at scale.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Delivers Powerful New Agentic AI Capabilities That Transform How Marketers Build and Deliver Customer Experiences
sfdc_news.summary: Braze launched BrazeAI Operator™, an in-dashboard AI assistant that enables marketers to create campaigns, build custom agents, generate content, and troubleshoot workflows with significantly reduced technical overhead. The release represents a major expansion of Braze's agentic AI offering, designed to lower the barrier to executing complex, personalised marketing strategies at scale.
sfdc_news.relevance: Marketers on the Braze platform can now use agentic AI to automate and accelerate campaign creation and personalisation, reducing reliance on engineering or data science resources.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Introduces Agentic AI Analytics for the Next Era of Product Experiences
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude unveiled a Global Agent and four specialised AI agents that continuously analyse product usage, surface what is and is not working, and recommend or take action in real time. MCP integrations bring Amplitude's behavioural data into tools such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, Figma, Lovable, Notion, and GitHub, while the Global Agent supports plain-language queries spanning funnels, experiments, segments, and customer journeys.
sfdc_news.relevance: Product and data teams can now interact with Amplitude analytics through natural language and embed insights directly into their existing tools, dramatically shortening the path from data to decision.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude June Product Release Highlights
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude's June 2026 release upgraded the User Profile Timeline to surface frustration signals—error events with distinct styling, key properties inline, and error-focused filtering—directly alongside behavioural events. The update adds quick links to Session Replay, giving product teams a chronological view of exactly what a specific user experienced to speed up root-cause analysis.
sfdc_news.relevance: Product and growth teams using Amplitude can now diagnose individual user friction faster and link behavioural data directly to session recordings, reducing time-to-fix for UX issues.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Named Snowflake 2026 APJ Product Growth Partner of the Year
sfdc_news.summary: Braze received Snowflake's 2026 APJ Product Growth Partner of the Year award alongside new industry competencies in retail, media and entertainment, and financial services. The partnership now supports real-time user profile streaming from Braze into Snowflake, enabling a 360-degree customer view, with Papa Johns UK reporting a 180% YoY uplift in SMS revenue as a result of the combined platform.
sfdc_news.relevance: Braze customers with Snowflake data warehouses can unlock richer real-time customer intelligence to power more targeted and timely marketing campaigns without duplicating data storage in Braze.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Introduces Services Track and Partner Hub of Claude Partner Network
claude_news.summary: Anthropic launched the Services Track and Partner Hub as part of the Claude Partner Network, designed to accelerate enterprise adoption of Claude across industries. The network connects businesses with certified service providers and implementation partners to help deploy Claude-powered solutions. This move expands the ecosystem around Claude beyond direct API access.
claude_news.relevance: The Partner Network makes it easier for enterprises to find vetted implementation partners, lowering the barrier to adopting Claude in production environments.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Scales Claude Mythos to Critical Infrastructure in 15+ Countries
claude_news.summary: Anthropic expanded Project Glasswing, its AI-powered vulnerability-discovery initiative, to 150 new organizations across more than 15 countries. Claude Mythos, described as Anthropic's most powerful model, powers the program and has been able to identify thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities over several weeks. The expansion now includes power, water, healthcare, communications, and hardware sectors that were underrepresented in the initial launch.
claude_news.relevance: Mythos represents Anthropic's frontier capability in cybersecurity, signaling a major new deployment domain for Claude models beyond typical enterprise use cases.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Files Confidentially for IPO as AI Giants Race to Go Public
claude_news.summary: Anthropic confidentially filed for an initial public offering on June 1, 2026, just days after closing a $65 billion Series H funding round that pushed its valuation to $965 billion. The company is targeting an October IPO, making it one of the most valuable private companies ever to go public. The filing comes ahead of rival OpenAI's own expected public offering.
claude_news.relevance: An Anthropic IPO would significantly increase public scrutiny and accountability of Claude's development roadmap and safety practices.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Raises $65 Billion at Record $965 Billion Valuation, Releases Claude Opus 4.8
claude_news.summary: Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H funding round, pushing its valuation to a record $965 billion, and simultaneously released Claude Opus 4.8 as the new default model for Max, Team Premium, Enterprise, and API tiers. The company also previewed Mythos, its next-generation frontier model, promising wide release within weeks. The fundraise cements Anthropic as one of the highest-valued private companies in history.
claude_news.relevance: Opus 4.8 is now the default model across paid Claude tiers, meaning most enterprise and API users are already on the latest generation.

claude_news.title: Anthropic's Code with Claude Showed Off Coding's Future—Whether You Like It or Not
claude_news.summary: MIT Technology Review covered Anthropic's Code with Claude event, which demonstrated advanced AI-assisted software development capabilities that sparked debate about the future role of human programmers. The event showcased Claude autonomously handling complex, multi-step coding tasks end-to-end. Reactions ranged from excitement about productivity gains to concern about displacement of software engineering roles.
claude_news.relevance: The Code with Claude demonstrations signal where Anthropic is investing in agentic coding capabilities, directly relevant to developers building on or competing with Claude.
